## Motivation

The MiniMax-H3 video VAE decode is dominated by its 36 ViT decoder blocks: 144 FP16 linears (`attn.to_qkv`, `attn.to_out`, `ff.w1`, `ff.w2`) run over every tile of every window, and there is no quantized checkpoint for the VAE. On 4x RTX PRO 5000 the decode stage takes 3.26 s of a 30 s five-step 768p request.

This PR converts those 144 linears to W8A8 FP8 once at load behind `--component-quantizations.video_vae fp8`: per-output-channel weight scales, dynamic per-token activation scales and the shared `apply_fp8_linear` dispatch, the recipe the DiT's online `--quantization fp8` already uses. The decode stage drops by 40% at a worst-frame PSNR of 51 dB against the FP16 decoder. It is a lossy, deployment-level option outside the quality levels: opt-in by flag, it changes the output at every level including `exact`, and the docs say so.

Stacked on #45179: the base is `main`, so this PR also includes #45179 and its cleanup. Merge #45179 first to isolate the FP8 changes. The FP8 decoder runs on #45179's batched decode and output kernels.

## Modifications

Shared FP8 linear (`runtime/layers/quantization/online_fp8_linear.py`):

- `OnlineFP8Linear.from_linear` quantizes a prepared FP16/BF16 CUDA `nn.Linear` with `per_token_group_quant_fp8(weight, in_features)` (per-output-channel e4m3 weights, the online recipe of `Fp8LinearMethod`), keeps the bias and runs `apply_fp8_linear` with dynamic per-token activation scales (CUTLASS / tuned-Triton dispatch). `forward_quantized` takes rows a fused producer already quantized (`input_scale`, `pre_quant_output_dtype`). Inference-only; dtypes are pinned across `.to()`.

H3 install (`minimax_h3_video_vae/fp8.py`, `loader/component_loaders/vae_loader.py`, `models/vaes/minimax_h3.py`, `configs/pipeline_configs/minimax_h3.py`):

- The flag reaches `MiniMaxH3VideoVAE.quantize_decoder_fp8` from the VAE loader before `optimize_vae`. `install_fp8_block_linears` validates the released 36-block / 144-linear scope (shapes and biases) before replacing anything, requires resident prepared FP16 weights, swaps the linears and decides once (`structure_reject_reason`) whether the blocks can run on the fused producers. Only those four linears per block change: the encoder, the patch embedding, the norms, the attention core (weightless Q/K RMSNorm + RoPE and SDPA) and the decoder output projection `proj_out` keep their precision. No other VAE accepts the option.
- Startup validation: `fp8` only; `--component-quantization-ignored-layers.video_vae` is rejected instead of silently ignored; CUDA SM100+, the FP16 decode autocast recipe (no `--component-precisions.video_vae`, no `--disable-autocast`) and a resident video VAE are required. The validated `quality: "high"` fingerprint gains `video_vae_quantization=None`, so a server started with the flag rejects `high` requests at admission.

Fused producers (JIT, SM100+; `kernels/jit/csrc/diffusion/minimax_h3_vae_residual_norm.cuh`, `silu_mul_quant_fp8.cuh`):

- `minimax_h3_vae_residual_rmsnorm_fp8` (FP32 residual update + RMSNorm + dynamic per-token e4m3 quantization), `minimax_h3_vae_rmsnorm_fp8` for the decoder input, `minimax_h3_vae_residual_layernorm` (the last residual folded into the output LayerNorm) and `silu_mul_quant_fp8` under `kernels/ops/diffusion/quantization/` (`silu(gate) * up` quantized without the 16-bit round trip). The quantization epilogue follows `per_token_quant_fp8`.
- `fused_decoder.block_forward` feeds each block from these and reuses `fused_inplace_qknorm_rope` for the weightless Q/K RMSNorm+RoPE. The producers run whenever the FP8 decoder is installed, at every quality level; per-call admission looks only at tensors (device, FP32 3-D input, rope table, no mask, no grad / compile / stream capture) and otherwise falls back to the eager FP8 path. The attention runs on the block's configured backend (`torch_sdpa` by default); it does not go through the cuDNN SDPA rebinding of the FP16 `lossless` path, so pass `--component-attention-backends video_vae=torch_cudnn_sdpa` to keep it on cuDNN.

Runtime weight updates and the decode-dtype store:

- `MiniMaxH3VideoVAE.validate_weight_update_source` rejects `/update_weights_from_disk` and `/update_weights_from_tensor` requests that include `video_vae` while the FP8 decoder is installed, before any weight is written: the updater's in-place copy would overwrite the e4m3 payload and leave the per-channel scales stale while reporting success. `WeightsUpdater` now runs the weight-update hooks on any module that defines them (previously `BaseDiT` only); without FP8 the VAE keeps taking updates.
- Applies to every MiniMax-H3 resident start, FP8 or not: `vae_loader._hold_decoder_weights_in_decode_dtype` writes and adopts the file-backed decode-dtype store only while the component's parameters live on the host. A store left by a host start (`--performance-mode auto` below 120 GiB) was otherwise adopted by a later resident start, which moved the CUDA FP16 decoder weights back to host mappings and failed the FP8 install; resident starts also no longer write an empty store.

Docs: cookbook section "Advanced: online FP8 video VAE decoder (deployment-level, lossy)" and the deployment-details bullet; the CLI reference rows for `--component-quantizations`; kernels README; `existing-fast-paths.md`; performance skill.

Tests:

- GPU (SM100+): `test/registered/kernels/ops/diffusion/test_minimax_h3_vae_fp8_decoder.py`: `OnlineFP8Linear` against the dequantized math and `forward_quantized` against `forward` on pre-quantized rows; two real decoder blocks fused vs eager FP8 on `TORCH_SDPA` and `TORCH_CUDNN_SDPA` (relative RMS < 1%, cosine > 0.99995); the installer swaps exactly the 144 linears and keeps `proj_out` / `x_embedder` FP32, while runtime weight-update rejection is covered by the CPU tests below. `test_minimax_h3_vae_fp8_producers.py`: against an eager reference (`F.rms_norm` / `F.layer_norm` / `F.silu`, then the dynamic per-token e4m3 quantizer), scales within fp32 rounding (rtol 3e-6), >= 99.9% identical e4m3 bins and a half-ulp bound on the dequantized values (shared `discrete_flip_rate` helper); FP32 residual / LayerNorm outputs within atol 4e-6 / rtol 3e-5; inputs with fewer than two dimensions, mismatched residual shapes or an odd gate/up width are rejected before `view` could reinterpret them.
- CPU: `test_server_args.py` (fp8 only, ignored layers rejected, SM100 / FP16-autocast / resident requirements), `test_vae_loader.py` (only the H3 video VAE admits the override, quantized before `optimize_vae`; with a CUDA device of any SM, a host-start store does not pull the FP8 decoder to the host), `test_vae_decoder_store.py` (a resident start neither adopts nor writes a store), `test_minimax_h3_vae_fp8_weight_update.py` (tensor and disk updates rejected before any write, a decoder without FP8 keeps taking updates).

## Accuracy Tests

Not bit-identical by design. Setup as in #45179: 4x RTX PRO 5000 (SM120), TP2 + Ulysses2, t2va 768p 16:9 5 s, 5 steps, seed 1101, default `torch_sdpa` for the video VAE; the reference is `main` (62cee1b15c, the rebase base) at the same quality level, so the DiT trajectory is identical and only the VAE differs. ffmpeg PSNR / SSIM on the decoded frames, audio compared as a hash. Two or three runs per row produced identical outputs.

| Decoder | Request | worst frame PSNR | mean PSNR | SSIM min | Audio |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| FP8 | `lossless` (default) | 51.4 dB | 51.9 dB | 0.995 | identical |
| FP8 | `exact` | 51.3 dB | 51.8 dB | 0.995 | identical |
| FP16, #45179 | `lossless` | 52.1 dB | 52.6 dB | 0.995 | identical |

On this clip the FP8 decoder costs about 0.7 dB on top of the FP16 batched decode; the fused producers (both FP8 rows) and the tile batching (the `lossless` row) do not add to it. On fl2va (first-frame conditioning) the previous revision of this branch measured a worst frame of 44.0 dB, next to 44.2 dB for its FP16 decode against the same reference; that clip's VAE-only difference is larger for both decoders.

Runtime weight update, live 4x SM120 server: before the fix, updating `video_vae` with the checkpoint's own weights reported success and the next request decoded at 26.8 dB worst-frame PSNR (SSIM min 0.52) against the pre-update output; with it the request is rejected before any write and the frames are bit-identical. Decode-dtype store: a `--performance-mode auto` start followed by an FP8 resident start now loads and decodes in the same time as a store-disabled run (before, the loader aborted).

Tests on SM120: `test_minimax_h3_vae_fp8_decoder.py` + `test_minimax_h3_vae_fp8_producers.py` + `test_minimax_h3_vae_output.py` + `test_model_fast_paths.py -k "minimax_h3 or h3_vae or fp8_linear"`, 45 passed. The MiniMax-H3 and VAE unit files pass on CPU (387 cases, with a CUDA device visible for the two store cases). No CI case compares the FP8 decoder with the FP16 decoder's output yet; the fidelity numbers above come from the end-to-end runs. The kernel tests are registered on the `4-gpu-b200` lane, so this PR's CI is their first run on SM100.

Tests on B200 (SM100, torch 2.14.1+cu130) after the rebase onto `main` 2da6c0c237: `test_minimax_h3_vae_output.py` + `test_minimax_h3_vae_fp8_decoder.py` + `test_minimax_h3_vae_fp8_producers.py` + `test_model_fast_paths.py`, 136 passed, 21 skipped, 1 failed (`test_ernie_qknorm_rope_is_bit_exact`, which fails identically on `main` and on the PR base in that environment; see #45179). CPU: the MiniMax-H3 and VAE unit files plus `test_server_args.py`, 349 passed; the one failure is a `main` MOVA case that needs Hub access.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Environment and protocol as in #45179 (4x RTX PRO 5000 72 GB SM120 PCIe, torch 2.14.1+cu130, CUDA 13.0, sgl-kernel 0.4.9, flashinfer 0.7.1; TP2 + Ulysses2, t2va 768p 5 s, 5 steps, blocks interleaved, `SGLANG_DIFFUSION_SYNC_STAGE_PROFILING=1`). Decode = `MiniMaxH3DecodingStage` duration; peak = runtime peak reserved.

| Decoder | Request | decode ms, median (min–max) | vs `main` same level | vs FP16 #45179 same level | peak reserved |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| FP16, `main` | `lossless` | 3258 (3252–3264), n=2 | | | 58120 MB |
| FP16, #45179 | `lossless` | 3158 (3147–3162), n=3 | −3.1% | | 58120 MB |
| FP8 | `lossless` | 1931 (1931–1937), n=3 | −40.7% | −38.9% | 56192 MB |
| FP16, `main` | `exact` | 3404 (3402–3406), n=3 | | | 58120 MB |
| FP16, #45179 | `exact` | 3400 (3391–3409), n=3 | within noise | | 58120 MB |
| FP8 | `exact` | 1998 (1989–2007), n=2 | −41.3% | −41.2% | 56190 MB |

Numbers are on the rebase base 62cee1b15c; `main`'s `exact` decode is slower than its `lossless` one there because #44690 dropped the Triton QK RMSNorm+RoPE the ViT attention ran at every level (see #45179). The `exact` row is the FP8 GEMMs plus the fused producers; `lossless` adds the tile batching (−3%). The previous revision gated the producers by quality level, and its `exact` row (FP8 GEMMs with the eager producers) measured 2098 (2096–2107) ms on 57db5089c2, so the producers are worth about 100 ms, or 5% of the FP8 decode time. | rows | op | split µs | fused µs |
|---:|---|---:|---:|
| 1792 | residual_rmsnorm_fp8 | 45.5 | 20.3 |
| 1792 | residual_layernorm | 42.6 | 20.4 |
| 1792 | rmsnorm_fp8 | 21.9 | 14.2 |
| 1792 | silu_mul_quant_fp8 | 66.1 | 50.8 |
| 7168 | residual_rmsnorm_fp8 | 261.7 | 132.1 |
| 7168 | silu_mul_quant_fp8 | 489.3 | 244.6 |

Not measured on the other SM100+ hardware the option accepts (B200 / B300, GB200 / GB300, RTX 5090 and the other SM120 cards); Hopper is rejected at startup. No benchmark script ships with this PR.

+"""H3 residual + norm + per-token FP8 producers (SM100+).
+
+Uses FP32 FMA and statistics, two-pass LayerNorm variance, and scale = amax/448.
+Zero rows produce zero scale and codes. Results are close, not bit-exact, to
+eager FP32 norm followed by FP8 quantization. Rows must be contiguous and
+16-byte aligned; affine vectors stay FP32.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.jit.utils import cache_once, load_jit, make_cpp_args
+from sglang.kernels.ops.diffusion.common.platform import is_cuda_sm_at_least
+from sglang.srt.utils.custom_op import register_custom_op
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from tvm_ffi.module import Module
+
+_MIN_SM = (10, 0)
+_ALIGNMENT = 16
+_ROW_DTYPES = (torch.float32, torch.float16)
+# kBlockSize * kVecSize in minimax_h3_vae_residual_norm.cuh.
+_WIDTH_MULTIPLE = 1024
+# The row lives in registers (width / 256 floats per thread); 2048 is the
+# verified MiniMax-H3 width, 4096 keeps the per-thread budget at 16 floats.
+_MAX_WIDTH = 4096
+
+_LAUNCHERS = {
+    "rmsnorm_fp8": "RmsNormFp8Kernel",
+    "residual_rmsnorm_fp8": "ResidualRmsNormFp8Kernel",
+    "residual_layernorm": "ResidualLayerNormKernel",
+}
+
+
+@cache_once
+def _jit_minimax_h3_vae_residual_norm_module(
+    mode: str, dtype: torch.dtype, projected_dtype: torch.dtype | None, width: int
+) -> Module:
+    if mode not in _LAUNCHERS:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Unknown MiniMax-H3 residual norm mode {mode!r}")
+    if dtype not in _ROW_DTYPES:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"Unsupported row dtype {dtype}; expected float32 or float16"
+        )
+    if (projected_dtype is None) != (mode == "rmsnorm_fp8"):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"mode {mode!r} takes a projected dtype iff residual")
+    if projected_dtype is not None and projected_dtype not in _ROW_DTYPES:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"Unsupported projected dtype {projected_dtype}; "
+            "expected float32 or float16"
+        )
+    if width <= 0 or width % _WIDTH_MULTIPLE != 0 or width > _MAX_WIDTH:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"Unsupported row width {width}; expected a multiple of "
+            f"{_WIDTH_MULTIPLE} up to {_MAX_WIDTH}"
+        )
+    dtypes = (dtype,) if projected_dtype is None else (dtype, projected_dtype)
+    args = make_cpp_args(*dtypes, width)
+    launcher = f"minimax_h3_vae_residual_norm::{_LAUNCHERS[mode]}<{args}>::run"
+    return load_jit(
+        "diffusion_minimax_h3_vae_residual_norm",
+        mode,
+        *args,
+        cuda_files=["diffusion/minimax_h3_vae_residual_norm.cuh"],
+        cuda_wrappers=[(mode, launcher)],
+    )
+
+
+@register_custom_op(mutates_args=["out_q", "out_s"])
+def minimax_h3_vae_rmsnorm_fp8_raw(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    out_q: torch.Tensor,
+    out_s: torch.Tensor,
+    eps: float,
+) -> None:
+    """``out_q, out_s = fp8(RMSNorm(x) * weight)`` on 2-D rows."""
+    module = _jit_minimax_h3_vae_residual_norm_module(
+        "rmsnorm_fp8", x.dtype, None, x.shape[-1]
+    )
+    module.rmsnorm_fp8(x, weight, out_q, out_s, eps)
+
+
+@register_custom_op(mutates_args=["residual_out", "out_q", "out_s"])
+def minimax_h3_vae_residual_rmsnorm_fp8_raw(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    projected: torch.Tensor,
+    layer_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    residual_out: torch.Tensor,
+    out_q: torch.Tensor,
+    out_s: torch.Tensor,
+    eps: float,
+) -> None:
+    """``residual_out = fma(projected, layer_scale, x)``, then RMSNorm + FP8."""
+    module = _jit_minimax_h3_vae_residual_norm_module(
+        "residual_rmsnorm_fp8", x.dtype, projected.dtype, x.shape[-1]
+    )
+    module.residual_rmsnorm_fp8(
+        x, projected, layer_scale, weight, residual_out, out_q, out_s, eps
+    )
+
+
+@register_custom_op(mutates_args=["out"])
+def minimax_h3_vae_residual_layernorm_raw(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    projected: torch.Tensor,
+    layer_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    bias: torch.Tensor,
+    out: torch.Tensor,
+    eps: float,
+) -> None:
+    """``out = LayerNorm(fma(projected, layer_scale, x)) * weight + bias``."""
+    module = _jit_minimax_h3_vae_residual_norm_module(
+        "residual_layernorm", x.dtype, projected.dtype, x.shape[-1]
+    )
+    module.residual_layernorm(x, projected, layer_scale, weight, bias, out, eps)
+
+
+def minimax_h3_vae_rmsnorm_fp8(
+    x: torch.Tensor, weight: torch.Tensor, *, eps: float
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Return ``(q, scales)``: fp8 e4m3 ``[M, width]`` and fp32 ``[M, 1]``."""
+    if x.dim() < 2:
+        raise ValueError("x must have at least two dimensions")
+    rows = x.view(-1, x.shape[-1])
+    out_q = torch.empty_like(rows, dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    out_s = torch.empty((rows.shape[0], 1), dtype=torch.float32, device=x.device)
+    minimax_h3_vae_rmsnorm_fp8_raw(rows, weight, out_q, out_s, float(eps))
+    return out_q, out_s
+
+
+def minimax_h3_vae_residual_rmsnorm_fp8(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    projected: torch.Tensor,
+    layer_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    eps: float,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Return ``(residual, q, scales)``; ``residual`` is fp32 with ``x.shape``."""
+    if x.dim() < 2 or projected.shape != x.shape:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "x and projected must have the same shape and at least two dimensions"
+        )
+    rows = x.view(-1, x.shape[-1])
+    residual = torch.empty_like(rows, dtype=torch.float32)
+    out_q = torch.empty_like(rows, dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    out_s = torch.empty((rows.shape[0], 1), dtype=torch.float32, device=x.device)
+    minimax_h3_vae_residual_rmsnorm_fp8_raw(
+        rows,
+        projected.view_as(rows),
+        layer_scale,
+        weight,
+        residual,
+        out_q,
+        out_s,
+        float(eps),
+    )
+    return residual.view(x.shape), out_q, out_s
+
+
+def minimax_h3_vae_residual_layernorm(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    projected: torch.Tensor,
+    layer_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    bias: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    eps: float,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Return the fp32 LayerNorm of the updated residual, shaped like ``x``."""
+    if x.dim() < 2 or projected.shape != x.shape:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "x and projected must have the same shape and at least two dimensions"
+        )
+    rows = x.view(-1, x.shape[-1])
+    out = torch.empty_like(rows, dtype=torch.float32)
+    minimax_h3_vae_residual_layernorm_raw(
+        rows, projected.view_as(rows), layer_scale, weight, bias, out, float(eps)
+    )
+    return out.view(x.shape)
+
+
+def _row_ok(x: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
+    return (
+        x.is_cuda
+        and x.dim() >= 2
+        and x.dtype in _ROW_DTYPES
+        and 0 < x.shape[-1] <= _MAX_WIDTH
+        and x.shape[-1] % _WIDTH_MULTIPLE == 0
+        and x.numel() > 0
+        and x.is_contiguous()
+        and x.data_ptr() % _ALIGNMENT == 0
+    )
+
+
+def _projected_ok(projected: torch.Tensor, x: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
+    return (
+        projected.shape == x.shape
+        and projected.dtype in _ROW_DTYPES
+        and projected.device == x.device
+        and projected.is_contiguous()
+        and projected.data_ptr() % _ALIGNMENT == 0
+    )
+
+
+def _vector_ok(vector: torch.Tensor, x: torch.Tensor) -> bool:

+"""SiLU(gate) * up with per-token FP8 quantization (SM100+).
+
+Computes in FP32 with expf and no intermediate FP16/BF16 rounding. Quantization
+uses scale = amax/448; zero rows produce zero scale and codes. Inputs must be
+contiguous and 16-byte aligned. Results are close, not bit-exact, to eager.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.jit.utils import cache_once, load_jit, make_cpp_args
+from sglang.kernels.ops.diffusion.common.platform import is_cuda_sm_at_least
+from sglang.srt.utils.custom_op import register_custom_op
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from tvm_ffi.module import Module
+
+_MIN_SM = (10, 0)
+_ALIGNMENT = 16
+_DTYPES = (torch.float16, torch.bfloat16)
+# kBlockSize * kVecSize in silu_mul_quant_fp8.cuh for 16-bit inputs.
+_WIDTH_MULTIPLE = 2048
+# The fp32 products live in registers (width / 256 floats per thread); 8192 is
+# the verified MiniMax-H3 FFN width and already 32 floats per thread.
+_MAX_WIDTH = 8192
+
+
+@cache_once
+def _jit_silu_mul_quant_fp8_module(dtype: torch.dtype, width: int) -> Module:
+    if dtype not in _DTYPES:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Unsupported dtype {dtype}; expected float16 or bfloat16")
+    if width <= 0 or width % _WIDTH_MULTIPLE != 0 or width > _MAX_WIDTH:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"Unsupported output width {width}; expected a multiple of "
+            f"{_WIDTH_MULTIPLE} up to {_MAX_WIDTH}"
+        )
+    args = make_cpp_args(dtype, width)
+    return load_jit(
+        "diffusion_silu_mul_quant_fp8",
+        *args,
+        cuda_files=["diffusion/silu_mul_quant_fp8.cuh"],
+        cuda_wrappers=[
+            (
+                "silu_mul_quant_fp8",
+                f"silu_mul_quant_fp8::SiluMulQuantFp8Kernel<{args}>::run",
+            )
+        ],
+    )
+
+
+@register_custom_op(mutates_args=["out_q", "out_s"])
+def silu_mul_quant_fp8_raw(
+    x: torch.Tensor, out_q: torch.Tensor, out_s: torch.Tensor
+) -> None:
+    """``out_q, out_s = fp8(silu(gate) * up)`` on 2-D ``[gate | up]`` rows."""
+    module = _jit_silu_mul_quant_fp8_module(x.dtype, out_q.shape[-1])
+    module.silu_mul_quant_fp8(x, out_q, out_s)
+
+
+def silu_mul_quant_fp8(x: torch.Tensor) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Return ``(q, scales)``: fp8 e4m3 ``[M, width]`` and fp32 ``[M, 1]``."""
+    if x.dim() < 2 or x.shape[-1] % 2:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "x must have at least two dimensions and an even gate/up width"
+        )
+    width = x.shape[-1] // 2
+    rows = x.view(-1, 2 * width)
+    out_q = torch.empty(
+        (rows.shape[0], width), dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn, device=x.device
+    )
+    out_s = torch.empty((rows.shape[0], 1), dtype=torch.float32, device=x.device)
+    silu_mul_quant_fp8_raw(rows, out_q, out_s)
+    return out_q, out_s
+
+
+def can_use_silu_mul_quant_fp8(x: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
+    return (
+        not torch.compiler.is_compiling()
+        and x.is_cuda
+        and x.dim() >= 2
+        and x.dtype in _DTYPES
+        and 0 < x.shape[-1] <= 2 * _MAX_WIDTH
+        and x.shape[-1] % (2 * _WIDTH_MULTIPLE) == 0
+        and x.numel() > 0
+        and x.is_contiguous()
+        and x.data_ptr() % _ALIGNMENT == 0
+        and is_cuda_sm_at_least(_MIN_SM, x.device)
+    )
+
+
+__all__ = [
+    "can_use_silu_mul_quant_fp8",
+    "silu_mul_quant_fp8",
+    "silu_mul_quant_fp8_raw",
+]

+"""Online W8A8 FP8 for plain ``nn.Linear`` modules of diffusers-native components.
+
+``OnlineFP8Linear.from_linear`` replaces a prepared fp16/bf16 ``nn.Linear`` at
+load with per-output-channel e4m3 weights (the recipe of ``Fp8LinearMethod``'s
+online path), dynamic per-token activation scales and the shared
+``apply_fp8_linear`` dispatch. ``forward_quantized`` takes rows a fused producer
+already quantized. Inference only.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from math import prod
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.quantization.fp8_kernel import per_token_group_quant_fp8
+from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.fp8_utils import (
+    apply_fp8_linear,
+    cutlass_fp8_supported,
+)
+
+FP8_DTYPE = torch.float8_e4m3fn
+
+
+class OnlineFP8Linear(nn.Module):
+    """Static per-channel FP8 weights, dynamic per-token FP8 activations."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        weight: torch.Tensor,
+        weight_scale: torch.Tensor,
+        bias: torch.Tensor | None,
+        *,
+        compute_dtype: torch.dtype,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        if weight.dtype != FP8_DTYPE or weight.dim() != 2:
+            raise ValueError("OnlineFP8Linear takes a 2-D e4m3 weight")
+        self.out_features, self.in_features = weight.shape
+        self.compute_dtype = compute_dtype
+        self.weight = nn.Parameter(weight, requires_grad=False)
+        # [1, out]: the per-channel layout apply_fp8_linear's GEMMs take.
+        self.register_buffer(
+            "weight_scale", weight_scale.reshape(1, -1).to(torch.float32).contiguous()
+        )
+        self.bias = None if bias is None else nn.Parameter(bias, requires_grad=False)
+        self._cutlass = cutlass_fp8_supported()
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_linear(cls, source: nn.Linear) -> OnlineFP8Linear:
+        compute_dtype = source.weight.dtype
+        if compute_dtype not in (torch.float16, torch.bfloat16):
+            raise ValueError("online FP8 quantizes an fp16 or bf16 linear")
+        if not source.weight.is_cuda:
+            raise ValueError("online FP8 quantizes a device-resident linear")
+        with torch.no_grad(), torch.autocast("cuda", enabled=False):
+            weight = source.weight.detach().contiguous()
+            qweight, scale = per_token_group_quant_fp8(weight, weight.shape[-1])
+            bias = None if source.bias is None else source.bias.detach()
+        module = cls(qweight, scale, bias, compute_dtype=compute_dtype)
+        module.train(source.training)
+        return module
+
+    def _apply(self, fn, recurse=True):
+        # Whole-component dtype scopes must not expand the FP8 payload or cast
+        # its scale, so moves are handled here and dtypes are pinned.
+        device = fn(
+            torch.empty(0, dtype=self.weight.dtype, device=self.weight.device)
+        ).device
+        if device.type not in ("cuda", "cpu"):
+            raise ValueError("OnlineFP8Linear supports CPU/CUDA moves only")
+        self.weight = nn.Parameter(
+            self.weight.detach().to(device=device, dtype=FP8_DTYPE),
+            requires_grad=False,
+        )
+        self.weight_scale = self.weight_scale.to(device=device, dtype=torch.float32)
+        if self.bias is not None:
+            self.bias = nn.Parameter(
+                self.bias.detach().to(device=device, dtype=self.compute_dtype),
+                requires_grad=False,
+            )
+        return self
+
+    def _check_inference(self) -> None:
+        if self.training or torch.is_grad_enabled():
+            raise RuntimeError("OnlineFP8Linear is inference-only")
+
+    def forward_quantized(self, values, scales, shape):
+        """GEMM on rows a producer already quantized (per-token fp32 scales)."""
+        self._check_inference()
+        if (
+            len(shape) < 2
+            or shape[-1] != self.in_features
+            or values.shape != (prod(shape[:-1]), self.in_features)
+            or values.dtype != FP8_DTYPE
+            or not values.is_contiguous()
+            or scales.shape != (values.shape[0], 1)
+            or scales.dtype != torch.float32
+            or not scales.is_contiguous()
+            or not values.is_cuda
+            or values.device != self.weight.device
+            or scales.device != values.device
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("unsupported pre-quantized FP8 activation")
+        with torch.autocast("cuda", enabled=False):
+            out = apply_fp8_linear(
+                values,
+                self.weight.t(),
+                self.weight_scale,
+                input_scale=scales,
+                bias=self.bias,
+                cutlass_fp8_supported=self._cutlass,
+                use_per_token_if_dynamic=True,
+                pre_quant_output_dtype=self.compute_dtype,
+            )
+        return out.reshape(*shape[:-1], self.out_features)
+
+    def forward(self, value):
+        self._check_inference()
+        if (
+            not value.is_cuda
+            or value.device != self.weight.device
+            or value.shape[-1] != self.in_features
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("unsupported OnlineFP8Linear activation")
+        with torch.autocast("cuda", enabled=False):
+            # Round the way the original Linear's autocast did before quantizing.
+            rows = value.to(self.compute_dtype).reshape(-1, self.in_features)
+            out = apply_fp8_linear(
+                rows.contiguous(),
+                self.weight.t(),
+                self.weight_scale,
+                bias=self.bias,
+                cutlass_fp8_supported=self._cutlass,
+                use_per_token_if_dynamic=True,
+            )
+        return out.reshape(*value.shape[:-1], self.out_features)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Online FP8 installation for the H3 decoder's 144 block linears.
+
+The opt-in deployment flag quantizes the four linears per block at load time.
+Other weights keep their precision; request quality does not control FP8.
+"""
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.quantization.online_fp8_linear import (
+    OnlineFP8Linear,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.utils.logging_utils import init_logger
+
+from .fused_decoder import structure_reject_reason
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+LINEAR_SHAPES = {
+    "attn.to_qkv": (6144, 2048),
+    "attn.to_out": (2048, 2048),
+    "ff.w1": (16384, 2048),
+    "ff.w2": (2048, 8192),
+}
+
+
+def inspect_fp8_scope(decoder):
+    if len(decoder.transformer_blocks) != 36:
+        raise ValueError("MiniMax-H3 online FP8 requires its 36-block decoder")
+    paths = []
+    for index, block in enumerate(decoder.transformer_blocks):
+        for suffix, shape in LINEAR_SHAPES.items():
+            name = f"transformer_blocks.{index}.{suffix}"
+            module = block.get_submodule(suffix)
+            if (
+                not isinstance(module, (nn.Linear, OnlineFP8Linear))
+                or tuple(module.weight.shape) != shape
+            ):
+                raise ValueError(f"Unexpected MiniMax-H3 FP8 linear scope: {name}")
+            if module.bias is None or module.bias.shape != (module.out_features,):
+                raise ValueError(f"Expected the released biased linear at {name}")
+            paths.append(name)
+    return paths
+
+
+def install_fp8_block_linears(decoder) -> int:
+    """Swap the block linears for FP8 modules; returns how many were replaced."""
+    if decoder.fp8_installed:
+        return 0
+    # Validate every target before replacing any module; an offloaded or
+    # unprepared decoder fails here with the original modules intact.
+    paths = inspect_fp8_scope(decoder)
+    decoder.prepare_autocast_linear_weights(torch.float16)
+    for path in paths:
+        source = decoder.get_submodule(path)
+        if source.weight.dtype != torch.float16 or not source.weight.is_cuda:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Online FP8 requires resident, prepared FP16 decoder weights"
+            )
+    for path in paths:
+        source = decoder.get_submodule(path)
+        decoder.set_submodule(path, OnlineFP8Linear.from_linear(source))
+    decoder.fp8_installed = True
+    decoder._autocast_linear_dtype = torch.float16
+    reason = structure_reject_reason(decoder)
+    decoder.fused_decoder_ready = reason is None
+    if reason is not None:
+        logger.info(
+            "MiniMax-H3 VAE: FP8 decoder blocks keep the eager producers (%s)", reason
+        )
+    return len(paths)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Fused dataflow for the MiniMax-H3 FP8 decoder.
+
+Each block folds the pending residual into RMSNorm and per-token FP8
+quantization, then fuses the gated FFN activation with quantization. The final
+residual feeds LayerNorm. Admission is all-or-nothing: unsupported inputs use
+eager FP8 blocks; kernel failures propagate.
+"""
+
+from typing import NamedTuple
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.diffusion import (
+    can_use_fused_inplace_qknorm_rope,
+    can_use_minimax_h3_vae_rmsnorm_fp8,
+    fused_inplace_qknorm_rope,
+    minimax_h3_vae_residual_layernorm,
+    minimax_h3_vae_residual_rmsnorm_fp8,
+    minimax_h3_vae_rmsnorm_fp8,
+    silu_mul_quant_fp8,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.quantization.online_fp8_linear import (
+    OnlineFP8Linear,
+)
+
+from .vit_utils import native_rope_cache
+
+
+class ResidualPending(NamedTuple):
+    """``residual + projected * scale`` left for the next norm kernel to apply."""
+
+    residual: torch.Tensor
+    projected: torch.Tensor
+    scale: torch.Tensor
+
+
+def _vector(value, size, device) -> bool:
+    return (
+        value is not None
+        and value.shape == (size,)
+        and value.dtype == torch.float32
+        and value.device == device
+        and value.is_contiguous()
+    )
+
+
+def _weightless_rmsnorm(module) -> bool:
+    return (
+        isinstance(module, nn.RMSNorm)
+        and module.weight is None
+        and module.eps is not None
+    )
+
+
+def _rope_ok(rope, *, batch, seq, dim_head, rope_dim, device) -> bool:
+    """The shared fp16 rotary table that ``native_rope_cache`` accepts for the
+    packed ``[batch, seq, heads, 3 * dim_head]`` QKV projection of every block."""
+    if len(rope) != 4:
+        return False
+    cache, positions = rope[2], rope[3]
+    return (
+        cache.device == device
+        and cache.dtype == torch.float16
+        and cache.shape == (seq, rope_dim)
+        and positions.device == device
+        and positions.shape in ((seq,), (batch * seq,))
+        and can_use_fused_inplace_qknorm_rope(
+            dim_head, rope_dim, True, torch.float16, torch.float16, True
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def _block_ok(block, *, width, dim_head, device) -> bool:
+    if not (
+        block.use_scale
+        and _vector(block.scale1, width, device)
+        and _vector(block.scale2, width, device)
+    ):
+        return False
+    for norm in (block.norm1, block.norm2):
+        if not (
+            isinstance(norm, nn.RMSNorm)
+            and _vector(norm.weight, width, device)
+            and norm.eps > 0
+        ):
+            return False
+    attn = block.attn
+    if not (
+        attn.dim_head == dim_head
+        and attn.attn is not None
+        and _weightless_rmsnorm(attn.norm_q)
+        and _weightless_rmsnorm(attn.norm_k)
+        and attn.norm_q.eps == attn.norm_k.eps
+    ):
+        return False
+    if not (block.ff.use_gated and isinstance(block.ff.act_fn, nn.SiLU)):
+        return False
+    return all(
+        isinstance(module, OnlineFP8Linear)
+        for module in (attn.to_qkv, attn.to_out, block.ff.w1, block.ff.w2)
+    )
+
+
+def structure_reject_reason(decoder) -> str | None:
+    """Why the installed decoder cannot run the fused producers, else None;
+    the installer asks once and per-call admission only looks at the tensors."""
+    if not isinstance(decoder.norm_out, nn.LayerNorm):
+        return "output norm is not a LayerNorm"
+    width = decoder.norm_out.normalized_shape[0]
+    device = decoder.norm_out.weight.device
+    if not (
+        _vector(decoder.norm_out.weight, width, device)
+        and _vector(decoder.norm_out.bias, width, device)
+    ):
+        return "output LayerNorm affine vectors are not fp32 contiguous"
+    dim_head = decoder.config.dim_head
+    for index, block in enumerate(decoder.transformer_blocks):
+        if not _block_ok(block, width=width, dim_head=dim_head, device=device):
+            return f"block {index} is not the released block layout"
+    return None
+
+
+def can_use_fused_decoder(decoder, value, rope) -> bool:
+    if not (decoder.fp8_installed and decoder.fused_decoder_ready):
+        return False
+    if (
+        torch.is_grad_enabled()
+        or torch.compiler.is_compiling()
+        or (torch.cuda.is_available() and torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing())
+    ):
+        return False
+    width = decoder.norm_out.normalized_shape[0]
+    first_norm = decoder.transformer_blocks[0].norm1
+    return (
+        value.is_cuda
+        and value.device == first_norm.weight.device
+        and value.dtype == torch.float32
+        and value.dim() == 3
+        and value.shape[-1] == width
+        and not decoder.mask_enabled
+        and _rope_ok(
+            rope,
+            batch=value.shape[0],
+            seq=value.shape[1],
+            dim_head=decoder.config.dim_head,
+            rope_dim=decoder.pos_embed.dim,
+            device=value.device,
+        )
+        # Later block inputs are fresh kernel and GEMM outputs; only the
+        # decoder input can violate the row layout the producers require.
+        and can_use_minimax_h3_vae_rmsnorm_fp8(
+            value, first_norm.weight, eps=first_norm.eps
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def _quantized_input(value, norm):
+    """fp32 residual plus the FP8 rows of ``RMSNorm(residual) * weight``."""
+    if isinstance(value, ResidualPending):
+        return minimax_h3_vae_residual_rmsnorm_fp8(
+            value.residual, value.projected, value.scale, norm.weight, eps=norm.eps
+        )
+    q, scales = minimax_h3_vae_rmsnorm_fp8(value, norm.weight, eps=norm.eps)
+    return value, q, scales
+
+
+def _attention(attn, q, scales, shape, rope, qk_weight):
+    """FP8 QKV GEMM, in-place weightless Q/K RMSNorm+RoPE, the block's attention."""
+    batch, seq = shape[0], shape[1]
+    packed = attn.to_qkv.forward_quantized(q, scales, shape).view(
+        batch, seq, attn.heads, 3 * attn.dim_head
+    )
+    query, key, value = torch.chunk(packed, 3, dim=-1)
+    native = native_rope_cache(query, key, rope)
+    if native is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "MiniMax-H3 fused decoder admitted a rotary table that its Q/K kernel "
+            "then refused for the packed QKV"
+        )
+    cache, positions = native
+    # The packed projection is this block's fresh GEMM output and nothing else
+    # reads it, so the strided Q/K views are normalized and rotated in place;
+    # unit weights make the kernel the model's weightless RMSNorm.
+    fused_inplace_qknorm_rope(
+        query.flatten(0, 1),
+        key.flatten(0, 1),
+        qk_weight,
+        qk_weight,
+        cache,
+        positions,
+        is_neox=True,
+        eps=attn.norm_q.eps,
+        head_dim=attn.dim_head,
+        rope_dim=cache.shape[1],
+        round_norm_before_rope=True,
+    )
+    attended = attn.attn(query, key, value).reshape(batch, seq, -1)
+    return attn.to_out(attended)
+
+
+def block_forward(module, value, rope, qk_weight):
+    """One decoder block; ``qk_weight`` is the fp16 unit weight of its Q/K norm."""
+    residual, q, scales = _quantized_input(value, module.norm1)
+    shape = tuple(residual.shape)
+    projected = _attention(module.attn, q, scales, shape, rope, qk_weight)
+    residual, q, scales = minimax_h3_vae_residual_rmsnorm_fp8(
+        residual, projected, module.scale1, module.norm2.weight, eps=module.norm2.eps
+    )
+    expanded = module.ff.w1.forward_quantized(q, scales, shape)
+    q, scales = silu_mul_quant_fp8(expanded)
+    projected = module.ff.w2.forward_quantized(
+        q, scales, (*shape[:-1], expanded.shape[-1] // 2)
+    )
+    # The last add stays pending: the next block folds it into its norm/quant
+    # kernel and the final block hands it to the output LayerNorm.
+    return ResidualPending(residual, projected, module.scale2)
+
+
+def finish(value, norm):
+    return minimax_h3_vae_residual_layernorm(
+        value.residual,
+        value.projected,
+        value.scale,
+        norm.weight,
+        norm.bias,
+        eps=norm.eps,
+    )

+"""An online-FP8 MiniMax-H3 video VAE refuses runtime weight updates.
+
+The updater copies checkpoint tensors into parameters. The FP8 block linears
+hold rounded payloads next to per-channel scales, so such a copy would serve a
+decoder whose scales no longer match its weights: the VAE rejects the update
+before any weight is written, through the same hook the DiT uses, while a
+decoder without the FP8 install keeps taking updates.
+"""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace

+import pytest

+import torch.nn as nn

+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.post_training.weights_updater import WeightsUpdater
+
+REJECTION = "--component-quantizations.video_vae fp8"
+
+
+class _Decoder(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.proj = nn.Linear(4, 4, bias=False)
+        self.fp8_installed = False
+
+
+def _video_vae(*, fp8_installed: bool) -> MiniMaxH3VideoVAE:
+    # The constructor builds the released 36-block decoder from a config; the
+    # hook under test reads only the decoder's installer flag.
+    vae = MiniMaxH3VideoVAE.__new__(MiniMaxH3VideoVAE)
+    nn.Module.__init__(vae)
+    vae.decoder = _Decoder()
+    vae.decoder.fp8_installed = fp8_installed
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        vae.decoder.proj.weight.zero_()
+    return vae
+
+
+def _updater(vae, model_path: str):
+    pipeline = SimpleNamespace(modules={"video_vae": vae}, model_path=model_path)
+    return WeightsUpdater(pipeline), pipeline
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fp8_installed", [False, True])
+def test_tensor_update_respects_fp8_installation(fp8_installed):
+    vae = _video_vae(fp8_installed=fp8_installed)
+    updater, _ = _updater(vae, "/unused")
+
+    ok, message = updater.update_weights_from_tensor(
+        [("decoder.proj.weight", torch.ones(4, 4))], target_modules=["video_vae"]
+    )
+
+    assert ok is not fp8_installed
+    if fp8_installed:
+        assert REJECTION in message
+    expected = torch.zeros(4, 4) if fp8_installed else torch.ones(4, 4)
+    assert torch.equal(vae.decoder.proj.weight, expected)
+
+
+def test_a_disk_update_is_rejected_before_any_weight_is_written(tmp_path):
+    vae = _video_vae(fp8_installed=True)
+    served = tmp_path / "served"
+    updater, pipeline = _updater(vae, str(served))
+    checkpoint = tmp_path / "new"
+    (checkpoint / "video_vae").mkdir(parents=True)
+    save_file(
+        {"decoder.proj.weight": torch.ones(4, 4)},
+        checkpoint / "video_vae" / "model.safetensors",
+    )
+
+    # The bare call is the documented default: every module, video_vae included.
+    ok, message = updater.update_weights_from_disk(str(checkpoint))
+
+    assert not ok
+    assert REJECTION in message
+    assert torch.equal(vae.decoder.proj.weight, torch.zeros(4, 4))
+    assert pipeline.model_path == str(served)

+"""FP8 producers of the MiniMax-H3 VAE decoder: fp32 residual + RMSNorm /
+LayerNorm with a dynamic per-token FP8 epilogue, and fp32 silu(gate) * up + FP8.
+
+References are public PyTorch operators (``F.rms_norm``, ``F.layer_norm``,
+``F.silu``) followed by the eager dynamic per-token quantizer. The kernels use
+a different fp32 reduction tree, so a value can land in the neighbouring E4M3
+bin; every FP8 check asserts exact scales, >= 99.9% identical bins and a
+pointwise half-ulp bound on the dequantized values.
+"""
+
+import sys
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.diffusion import (
+    can_use_minimax_h3_vae_residual_layernorm,
+    can_use_minimax_h3_vae_residual_rmsnorm_fp8,
+    can_use_minimax_h3_vae_rmsnorm_fp8,
+    can_use_silu_mul_quant_fp8,
+    minimax_h3_vae_residual_layernorm,
+    minimax_h3_vae_residual_rmsnorm_fp8,
+    minimax_h3_vae_rmsnorm_fp8,
+    silu_mul_quant_fp8,
+)
+from sglang.kernels.ops.diffusion.common.platform import is_cuda_sm_at_least
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.test.quality_tier_admission import discrete_flip_rate
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=40, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="4-gpu-b200")
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not is_cuda_sm_at_least((10, 0)),
+    reason="MiniMax-H3 VAE FP8 producers are gated to SM100+",
+)
+
+WIDTH = 2048
+FFN_WIDTH = 8192
+EPS = 1e-5
+FP8_MAX = 448.0
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def inference():
+    torch.manual_seed(20260920)
+    with torch.inference_mode():
+        yield
+
+
+def record_error(record_property, actual, expected, prefix="output"):
+    difference = (actual.float() - expected.float()).abs()
+    finite = difference[torch.isfinite(difference)]
+    if finite.numel():
+        record_property(f"{prefix}_max_abs", finite.max().item())
+        record_property(f"{prefix}_rms_abs", finite.square().mean().sqrt().item())
+
+
+def check_fp8(q, scales, reference, record_property):
+    reference = reference.reshape(q.shape)
+    expected_scale = reference.abs().amax(dim=-1, keepdim=True) / FP8_MAX
+    torch.testing.assert_close(scales, expected_scale, atol=1e-8, rtol=3e-6)
+    expected_q = (
+        (reference / expected_scale.clamp_min(torch.finfo(torch.float32).tiny))
+        .clamp(-FP8_MAX, FP8_MAX)
+        .to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    )
+    mismatch = discrete_flip_rate(expected_q.view(torch.uint8), q.view(torch.uint8))
+    record_property("fp8_boundary_mismatch_fraction", mismatch)
+    # A different reduction tree can move values across an E4M3 midpoint.
+    # Require >99.9% identical bins as well as a pointwise half-ULP error bound.
+    assert mismatch <= 1e-3
+    dequantized = q.float() * scales
+    error = (dequantized - reference).abs()
+    bound = 0.063 * reference.abs() + scales / 1024 + 1e-6
+    assert torch.all(error <= bound).item()
+    record_error(record_property, dequantized, reference, "dequantized")
+    zero_rows = expected_scale.squeeze(-1) == 0
+    if zero_rows.any():
+        assert torch.count_nonzero(q.float()[zero_rows]) == 0
+        assert torch.count_nonzero(scales[zero_rows]) == 0
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", [torch.float32, torch.float16])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("shape", [(1, WIDTH), (2, 7, WIDTH)])
+def test_rmsnorm_fp8(dtype, shape, record_property):
+    x = torch.randn(shape, dtype=dtype, device="cuda")
+    if x.numel() > WIDTH:
+        x.view(-1, WIDTH)[0].zero_()
+    weight = torch.randn(WIDTH, device="cuda")
+    assert can_use_minimax_h3_vae_rmsnorm_fp8(x, weight, eps=EPS)
+    q, scales = minimax_h3_vae_rmsnorm_fp8(x, weight, eps=EPS)
+    rows = x.numel() // WIDTH
+    assert q.shape == (rows, WIDTH) and q.dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn
+    assert scales.shape == (rows, 1) and scales.dtype == torch.float32
+    reference = F.rms_norm(x.float(), (WIDTH,), weight, eps=EPS)
+    check_fp8(q, scales, reference, record_property)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", [torch.float32, torch.float16])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("projected_dtype", [torch.float16, torch.float32])
+def test_residual_rmsnorm_fp8(dtype, projected_dtype, record_property):
+    x = torch.randn(2, 7, WIDTH, dtype=dtype, device="cuda")
+    projected = torch.randn(2, 7, WIDTH, dtype=projected_dtype, device="cuda")
+    x[0, 0].zero_()
+    projected[0, 0].zero_()
+    layer_scale = torch.randn(WIDTH, device="cuda") * 0.3
+    weight = torch.randn(WIDTH, device="cuda")
+    assert can_use_minimax_h3_vae_residual_rmsnorm_fp8(
+        x, projected, layer_scale, weight, eps=EPS
+    )
+    residual, q, scales = minimax_h3_vae_residual_rmsnorm_fp8(
+        x, projected, layer_scale, weight, eps=EPS
+    )
+    expected_residual = x.float() + projected.float() * layer_scale
+    assert residual.shape == x.shape and residual.dtype == torch.float32
+    torch.testing.assert_close(residual, expected_residual, atol=1e-6, rtol=2e-6)
+    reference = F.rms_norm(expected_residual, (WIDTH,), weight, eps=EPS)
+    check_fp8(q, scales, reference, record_property)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", [torch.float16, torch.float32])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("projected_dtype", [torch.float16, torch.float32])
+def test_residual_layernorm(dtype, projected_dtype, record_property):
+    x = torch.randn(2, 7, WIDTH, device="cuda", dtype=dtype)
+    projected = torch.randn(2, 7, WIDTH, device="cuda", dtype=projected_dtype)
+    layer_scale = torch.randn(WIDTH, device="cuda") * 0.3
+    weight, bias = torch.randn(2, WIDTH, device="cuda")
+    reference = F.layer_norm(
+        x.float() + projected.float() * layer_scale, (WIDTH,), weight, bias, EPS
+    )
+    assert can_use_minimax_h3_vae_residual_layernorm(
+        x, projected, layer_scale, weight, bias, eps=EPS
+    )
+    out = minimax_h3_vae_residual_layernorm(
+        x, projected, layer_scale, weight, bias, eps=EPS
+    )
+    assert out.shape == x.shape and out.dtype == torch.float32
+    record_error(record_property, out, reference)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out, reference, atol=4e-6, rtol=3e-5)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", [torch.float16, torch.bfloat16])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("rows", [1, 7, 257])
+def test_silu_mul_quant_fp8(dtype, rows, record_property):
+    x = torch.randn(rows, 2 * FFN_WIDTH, device="cuda", dtype=dtype)
+    if rows > 1:
+        x[0].zero_()
+    gate, up = x.float().chunk(2, dim=-1)
+    reference = F.silu(gate) * up
+    assert can_use_silu_mul_quant_fp8(x)
+    q, scales = silu_mul_quant_fp8(x)
+    assert q.shape == (rows, FFN_WIDTH) and q.dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn
+    assert scales.shape == (rows, 1) and scales.dtype == torch.float32
+    check_fp8(q, scales, reference, record_property)
+
+
+def test_silu_mul_quant_fp8_flattens_leading_dims(record_property):
+    x = torch.randn(2, 5, 2 * FFN_WIDTH, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float16)
+    gate, up = x.float().chunk(2, dim=-1)
+    q, scales = silu_mul_quant_fp8(x)
+    assert q.shape == (10, FFN_WIDTH) and scales.shape == (10, 1)
+    check_fp8(q, scales, F.silu(gate) * up, record_property)
+
+
+def test_reject_unsupported_inputs():
+    x = torch.randn(2, 7, WIDTH, device="cuda")
+    projected = torch.randn_like(x, dtype=torch.float16)
+    weight, bias = torch.randn(2, WIDTH, device="cuda")
+    assert not can_use_minimax_h3_vae_rmsnorm_fp8(x.cpu(), weight.cpu(), eps=EPS)
+    assert not can_use_minimax_h3_vae_rmsnorm_fp8(x, weight.half(), eps=EPS)
+    assert not can_use_minimax_h3_vae_rmsnorm_fp8(x, weight, eps=0.0)
+    assert not can_use_minimax_h3_vae_rmsnorm_fp8(x.transpose(0, 1), weight, eps=EPS)
+    assert not can_use_minimax_h3_vae_rmsnorm_fp8(
+        x[..., : WIDTH // 2], weight[: WIDTH // 2], eps=EPS
+    )
+    assert not can_use_minimax_h3_vae_residual_rmsnorm_fp8(
+        x, projected[0], weight, weight, eps=EPS
+    )
+    assert not can_use_minimax_h3_vae_residual_layernorm(
+        x, projected, weight, weight, bias.half(), eps=EPS
+    )
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="at least two dimensions"):
+        minimax_h3_vae_rmsnorm_fp8(x[0, 0], weight, eps=EPS)
+    # Equal element counts must not hide different original tensor shapes.
+    for residual, update in (
+        (x, projected.view(7, 2, WIDTH)),
+        (x[0, 0], projected[0, 0]),
+    ):
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="same shape and at least two dimensions"):
+            minimax_h3_vae_residual_rmsnorm_fp8(
+                residual, update, weight, weight, eps=EPS
+            )
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="same shape and at least two dimensions"):
+            minimax_h3_vae_residual_layernorm(
+                residual, update, weight, weight, bias, eps=EPS
+            )
+    # A contiguous slice can still be misaligned for the vectorized loads.
+    offset_rows = torch.empty(2 * WIDTH + 4, device="cuda")[1 : 2 * WIDTH + 1]
+    offset_rows = offset_rows.view(2, WIDTH)
+    assert offset_rows.is_contiguous() and offset_rows.data_ptr() % 16 != 0
+    assert not can_use_minimax_h3_vae_rmsnorm_fp8(offset_rows, weight, eps=EPS)
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="aligned"):
+        minimax_h3_vae_rmsnorm_fp8(offset_rows, weight, eps=EPS)
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
+        minimax_h3_vae_rmsnorm_fp8(x, weight.half(), eps=EPS)
+    offset_ffn = torch.empty(2 * FFN_WIDTH + 1, dtype=torch.float16, device="cuda")
+    offset_ffn = offset_ffn[1:].view(1, 2 * FFN_WIDTH)
+    assert offset_ffn.is_contiguous() and offset_ffn.data_ptr() % 16 != 0
+    assert not can_use_silu_mul_quant_fp8(offset_ffn)
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="aligned"):
+        silu_mul_quant_fp8(offset_ffn)
+    assert not can_use_silu_mul_quant_fp8(
+        torch.randn(3, 2 * 1536, device="cuda").half()
+    )
+    assert not can_use_silu_mul_quant_fp8(torch.randn(3, 2 * FFN_WIDTH, device="cuda"))
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="width"):
+        silu_mul_quant_fp8(torch.randn(3, 2 * 1536, device="cuda").half())
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="at least two dimensions"):
+        silu_mul_quant_fp8(
+            torch.empty(2 * FFN_WIDTH, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float16)
+        )
+    # Flattening this odd width used to reinterpret it as 4097 valid 4096-wide rows.
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="even gate/up width"):
+        silu_mul_quant_fp8(torch.empty(4096, 4097, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float16))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(pytest.main([__file__, "-v", "-s"]))
